races.paceDynamic: Amiata is the sole confirmed front-runner and will likely dictate a sustainable pace without early pressure, with Joyful Tidings, Treasured Royal, and Wearing Stars settling prominently behind. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo could be moderate early, allowing the field to stay compact through halfway before quickening in the final 2f. With most runners having prominent or hold-up styles, the race will develop into a sprint finish where position and timing become crucial. This pace scenario clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick, as they'll have the tactical advantage over hold-up horses who may find themselves too far back when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Amiata sets an uncontested lead with moderate fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stalk comfortably and time their challenges perfectly, while hold-up horses get caught flat-footed when the pace lifts. Joyful Tidings and Bad Boy Rizz benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Amiata goes faster than expected or gets company early from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates opportunities for the hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Allsortz and All The Girls can capitalize on the stronger pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Then Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow with runners reluctant to commit until late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins, potentially suiting horses with high cruising speed. This Guy and Coincidental Glory could benefit from their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Amiata goes too slow and the field bunches up approaching the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where draw and racing room matter most, creating opportunities for outsiders. Fontaine Khaled and Whistling Jamesie could sneak through gaps.

runners_data.name: Heavenly Power

runners_data.name: Indigo Dream

races.paceDynamic: Valiant Force is the only confirmed front runner in this 13-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure and set a sustainable pace. The prominent runners like Headmaster, Howd'yadoit, Staysound Susie, Indigo Dream and Bishopton will settle just off the pace, while the hold-up horses including Tango Flare, Heavenly Power, City House and Keke will need to rely on late finishing kicks. With one lone leader over 6f on good to yielding ground, this race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the even gallop and time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force sets an even tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows the closers to conserve energy and produce strong finishing kicks in the final furlong. Horses like Tango Flare, Heavenly Power and Keke get the run of the race from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack applies enough pressure to Valiant Force mid-race
scenarios.body: A slightly stronger tempo stretches the field and favours those positioned handily in second or third. Headmaster and Howd'yadoit are best placed to capitalize on this tactical position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner gets away
scenarios.trigger: If Valiant Force gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to store energy for a decisive move, making it difficult for closers to reel him in. His recent Dundalk form suggests he has the engine to sustain a front-running effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to race prominently early and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: A sprint finish from the turn heavily favours those with the most natural speed regardless of position. The race becomes a lottery with pace advantage negated completely.

races.paceDynamic: Bonus Time looks the sole confirmed front-runner and should dictate terms uncontested through the early stages. With most others sitting prominent or held up, he'll likely get an uncontested lead before the field closes late over this sharp 5f. The lack of early pace pressure means those with tactical speed to position well - prominent runners like Bucanero Fuerte, Mission Central and Big Gossey - can track the leader without being bustled along. This pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and kick, rather than pure hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground from the back in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Bonus Time gets soft fractions and stays strong to the line
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to conserve energy before others can mount their challenges. Those sitting closest like Mission Central and Bucanero Fuerte benefit from the perfect stalking trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway as the field bunches up
scenarios.body: The tactical speed merchants can position perfectly and time their runs to perfection. Bucanero Fuerte and Mission Central have the class to exploit the setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely pedestrian and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses like King Cuan and Thunderbear get the perfect scenario to unleash their finishing kicks. The slow pace plays into their hands completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Bonus Time stops quickly and leaves a tactical void
scenarios.body: Early prominent runners suddenly find themselves further forward than intended, creating chaos. Those with instant acceleration like Fahrenheit Seven can capitalize on the confusion.

races.paceDynamic: Jamestown is the sole confirmed front runner and will lead from the start, creating a steady rhythm at 1m. With Controlled and Trojan Warrior positioned prominently behind him, there's no pressure to inject early pace. The mid-division and hold-up horses including Bobby McGee, Son Of Beauty, Alphecca, and Invincible Will will be covered up in the main body. This sets up a moderate tempo that allows the race to develop into a sprint finish, clearly favouring prominent racers and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who need a stronger pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows prominent runners to dictate
scenarios.body: Controlled and Trojan Warrior can position perfectly behind Jamestown and kick clear when it matters. The steady tempo plays directly into their hands as pure hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Jamestown maintains his lead throughout without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to control the race from pillar to post. His proven front-running ability at shorter trips could translate effectively to this longer distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows a patient ride to pay dividends
scenarios.body: Invincible Will or Alphecca could benefit from sitting back and producing a late surge. Their hold-up style needs everything to fall right including finding racing room in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexposed Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Felix Guido's Polish form translates effectively to Irish handicapping
scenarios.body: His unbeaten record suggests genuine ability but the step up in class and new environment creates uncertainty. O'Brien's booking suggests confidence despite the unknown quantity.
